source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 36 (subst. by Mah. 32 of 2005 s.5(11) w.e.f. 7-5-2005; conveyance rates per Mah. 59 of 2017)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 36 (both columns, IGR text): 'LEASE, including under lease or sub-lease and any agreement to let or sub-let or any renewal of lease — Where such lease purports to be — (i) for a period not exceeding five years — the same duty as is leviable on a conveyance under clause (a),(b) or (c) of article 25, on 10 per centum of the market value of the property; (ii) for a period exceeding five years but not exceeding ten years, with a renewal clause contingent or otherwise — ... on 25 per centum of the market value; (iii) for a period exceeding ten years but not exceeding twenty-nine years ... — ... on 50 per centum of the market value; (iv) for a period exceeding twenty-nine years or in perpetuity, or does not purport for any definite period ... — ... on 90 per centum of the market value.' Explanation I — premium/money advanced/security deposit, by whatever name, is treated as consideration passed on. Explanation II — a specified renewal period is treated as part of the present lease.

pending_verification.reason: Article 36 market value and term must account for every premium, advance, deposit, and renewal period in the document. The engine derives the safe scope from observable completeness answers and refuses if anything is unentered or uncertain.
Lease totals may omit Local Body Tax or another local levy. Compute only for a location positively confirmed free of omitted local surcharges.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official IGR text). Duty = area-based Conveyance rate (Art 25) applied to a term-dependent PERCENTAGE of market value: ≤5y → 10%; >5≤10y → 25%; >10≤29y → 50%; >29y/perpetuity/no-definite → 90%. Boundaries in months: 60 / 120 / 348 (29y=348mo) / else. IMPORTANT: 'market_value' here must include every premium/deposit/security amount treated as consideration, and term_months must include renewal periods. The shared contract asks whether any such item remains unentered and derives lease_value_scope internally only from two explicit 'no' answers. No perpetuity escalation needed (clause iv is the catch-all at 90%). Metro cess/LBT PENDING as for conveyance. BACK-CATALOGUE: effective_from moved to the 2015 floor — this article did not change in 2017; only the Conveyance rate it cross-refs did, and the cross-ref resolves per execution date within the snapshot, so no re-versioning is needed here.
